meta.name: orchestrate
meta.description: This skill should be used at the boundary where work crosses from intent to execution: a goal that needs breaking down and delegating, or a plan that has converged (in conversation or plan mode) and is ready to build. Explicit asks to "orchestrate" or "cascade" work also invoke it. Coordinate the cascade hierarchy - slice the goal or plan vertically, delegate each slice to a lead for planning and delivery, review and approve plans, and sign off on results.

copy.tagline: 把大目标拆成小任务，分派给多个助手并统一把关验收
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你想将大目标交给多个智能体分头完成并统一验收
copy.tagline_en: Break down big goals, delegate to multiple agents, and review results
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have complex goals that need splitting across multiple AI agents with oversight

howto.what: Claude 会把目标或已定稿的计划纵向切成若干切片,逐个交给子代理规划与交付,自己审核计划、验收结果并最终签字确认。
howto.when: 当目标需要拆解并分派,或计划已在对话/计划模式中收敛并准备落地时;直接要求“orchestrate”或“cascade”也会触发。

say.text: 请 orchestrate 这个目标:把注册流程上线。
say.note: Claude 会拆解目标并分派子代理。

say.text: 计划已收敛,cascade 一下,开始拆分执行。
say.note: 按计划切片,交给子代理规划与交付。

say.text: orchestrate:把我刚才确认的方案拆成可交付的切片。
say.note: 按已确认方案切片并逐片验收。

howto.what_en: Claude takes the goal or converged plan and splits it into vertical slices, delegates each slice to a subagent lead for planning and delivery, reviews and approves plans, validates results, and signs off.
howto.when_en: Triggers when a goal needs breaking down and delegating, when a plan has converged in conversation or plan mode and is ready to build, or when the user explicitly asks to 'orchestrate' or 'cascade' the work.

say_en.text: Please orchestrate this goal: ship the registration flow.
say_en.note: Claude breaks the goal into slices and delegates them.

say_en.text: The plan has converged; cascade it and start splitting.
say_en.note: Splits the plan into slices and hands them to subagents.

say_en.text: Orchestrate: break the approved plan into deliverable slices.
say_en.note: Slices the plan and validates each one.
